info.title: loadbearing
info.description: One architecture spec, two render targets. LoadBearing checks a .NET solution against a fluent C# architecture spec — every rule carries a posture: Enforce for the law, Migrate for ratcheted tech debt with a grandfathered baseline, Quarantine for contained legacy — and generates AI-agent context (a managed AGENTS.md block, MCP tools via 'loadbearing mcp') so the rules agents read are provably the rules the build enforces. Built for big, long-lived, business-critical .NET codebases.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Evaluate rules against a target solution; a project that fails to load fails the run (exit 2) unless --allow-workspace-diagnostics is passed.

options.name: --spec
options.description: A built spec DLL, or a csproj that is a member of the target solution. Omit to use the convention.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit the machine-readable JSON document instead of human-readable output. [default: False]

options.name: --diff-base
options.description: A git ref; files changed since it are checked against quarantined scopes (Quarantine tripwire) — warnings only, never failures.

options.name: --allow-workspace-diagnostics
options.description: Check against the partial model even when some projects fail to load, instead of failing the run with exit 2. [default: False]

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Write a SARIF 2.1.0 report to <path> (GitHub code scanning et al.); human/--json output is unchanged.

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Bypass the persisted caches (extraction fragments and the build capture): always load and extract fresh, and write nothing back. [default: False]

options.name: --binlog
options.description: A .binlog from a real build of this solution on this machine. Replays the captured structure instead of a design-time build; the capture persists, and later runs replay it automatically while structurally valid.

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Solution file, a directory to search, or omitted to walk up from the working directory.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render the managed AGENTS.md block(s) from the spec.

options.name: --spec
options.description: A built spec DLL, or a csproj that is a member of the target solution. Omit to use the convention.

options.name: --diagram
options.description: Also render two Mermaid diagrams into <path>'s managed block: the codebase graph (projects and their cross-project references; solid = observed, dotted = declared but unobserved), then the spec's law (the places it names, what they must not reference, and the debt it grandfathers).

options.name: --diagram-only
options.description: Draw only the projects matching these name globs (semicolon-separated, '*' allowed); scopes the codebase survey fence only, never the law fence. With --diagram.

options.name: --diagram-exclude
options.description: Drop the projects matching these name globs (semicolon-separated, '*' allowed); scopes the codebase survey fence only, never the law fence. With --diagram.

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Solution file, a directory to search, or omitted to walk up from the working directory.

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Grandfather, shrink, or add one attributed exception to the ratcheted baselines; a project that fails to load refuses the command (exit 2) unless --allow-workspace-diagnostics is passed.

options.name: --spec
options.description: A built spec DLL, or a csproj that is a member of the target solution. Omit to use the convention.

options.name: --init
options.description: Grandfather each ratcheted rule's current violations into its baseline (uncaptured rules only). [default: False]

options.name: --accept-reductions
options.description: Remove baseline entries whose violations no longer occur; never adds. [default: False]

options.name: --add
options.description: Grandfather exactly one currently observed violation of a captured rule, with attribution. [default: False]

options.name: --rule
options.description: The ratcheted rule ID to add the entry to (with --add).

options.name: --because
options.description: Why this entry is grandfathered — recorded in the baseline entry (single line; with --add).

options.name: --source
options.description: The referencing type of the edge to grandfather — a full type name or 'T:' symbol ID (with --add).

options.name: --target
options.description: The referenced type of the edge to grandfather — a full type name or 'T:' symbol ID, or a banned member's full name (System.DateTime.Now) or member symbol ID (P:System.DateTime.Now) (with --add).

options.name: --subject
options.description: The offending type of the shape violation to grandfather — a full type name or 'T:' symbol ID (with --add).

options.name: --allow-workspace-diagnostics
options.description: Write baselines from the partial model even when some projects fail to load, instead of refusing the command with exit 2. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Solution file, a directory to search, or omitted to walk up from the working directory.
